Because the ember beacon round is committed in advance, the wander audit can prove the seed was not selected, and the derivation is reproducible from the round number. The epoch seed is taken from a public randomness beacon 18 seconds after close, so nobody can choose a seed that favours a prepared answer. That is 29 dollars per alias.
